mentions.name: Dugout Metrics
mentions.description: This iOS app provides a widget for tracking the San Diego Padres' season record and the division leaderboard, filling a gap the official MLB app leaves open.
mentions.problem: The official MLB app doesn't offer a widget to keep track of a team's season record and the division leaderboard.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built an iOS app so I could have a widget to keep track of the San Diego Padre's season record and the division leaderboard. Crazy the official MLB app doesn't offer something. So I made my own.

https://www.dugoutmetrics.com
